name: meshioplusplus
description: C++ core for the meshio++ mesh I/O library (installable C API).

hdf5.description: HDF5-backed formats (CGNS, HMF, H5M, MED, XDMF-HDF)

gidpost.description: GiD postprocess writer, on a vendored hardcopy of gidpost 2.14 (hard-gated on the zlib feature)

zstd.description: VTK XML zstd block compression (meshio++ extension; ParaView cannot read it)

lz4.description: VTK XML lz4 block compression (vtkLZ4DataCompressor; ParaView-readable)

kahip.description: KaHIP partition backend (no vcpkg port exists: supply an install and set KAHIP_ROOT)

cgnslib.description: Official CGNS library backend: ADF-container files and NGON_n/NFACE_n polyhedral sections (needs the hdf5 feature)

cxx-api.description: The full C++ API (meshioplusplus::core) alongside the flat C API

cxx-api-kratos.description: Also build meshioplusplus::core_kratos, for Kratos Multiphysics consumers (implies cxx-api)
